number.why: The served HR 0.70 (95% CI 0.54–0.90) is explicitly reported for first HHF with pooled ertugliflozin versus placebo, using intention-to-treat analysis and all on-study follow-up. The registry's more precise confidence limits round to the served limits.

quotes.span: The outcome of risk for first HHF was lower in patients on ertugliflozin (pooled doses) versus placebo (139/5499 [2.5%] versus 99/2747 [3.6%]; HR, 0.70 [95% CI, 0.54–0.90]; P =0.006).
Analyses were performed on an intention-to-treat basis using all randomly assigned patients and all time on-study for each patient comparing the effects of pooled ertugliflozin versus placebo.

entry.why: The trial enrolled adults with type 2 diabetes and established cardiovascular disease, including participants with and without baseline HF. This satisfies the question's mixed-HF population.

quotes.span: ELIGIBILITY AGE/SEX: minimum age 40 Years | maximum age None | sex ALL
we randomly assigned patients with type 2 diabetes and atherosclerotic cardiovascular disease to receive 5 mg or 15 mg of ertugliflozin or placebo once daily.

In these prespecified analyses, previous HF status did not modify the effect of ertugliflozin on risk for first HHF: previous HF (ertugliflozin 69/1286 [5.4%]; placebo 55/672 [8.2%]) HR, 0.63 (95% CI, 0.44–0.90) versus no previous HF (ertugliflozin 70/4213 [1.7%]; placebo 44/2075 [2.1%]) HR, 0.79 (95% CI, 0.54–1.15; P interaction=0.40).
